# Supply the OH host while retaining portable Dart logic

## Platform difference

Flutter widgets and pure Dart logic can remain shared; the application still needs an OH-native host and its packaging configuration.

## Implementation

Snake adds FlutterAbility/FlutterPage, module metadata and a local Flutter HAR reference while retaining the timer-driven game and widget rendering. Shuqi, PixEz and PiliPlus likewise introduce the native shell. Snake has no application plugins in its registrant, whereas the readers have native dependency boundaries. SSH Codex generates the host from a preparation script instead of checking it in: host absence in Git is not by itself absence of an OH build path.

## Applicability

Use this distinction for projects with different amounts of native functionality. Host templates and HAR wiring must match the chosen Flutter OH version.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

A generated host proves neither feature parity nor a reproducible signed HAP. Snake retains example identity/signing prerequisites. Unchanged Dart code can still invoke plugins without OH handlers, as Shuqi demonstrates.

## Verification

Build with the intended SDK and local signing; launch the real entrypoint and exercise each platform-boundary feature rather than accepting the counter page.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
